content: Jesusen teneni quescajati

Jaa hen yohihah nincacoinaibo ta hicha qui, nai cohin tsamati quescapi. Jaabaan teneni quescajati ta jaiqui. Coshin bishquihihcananoxon jatihibi hihuebo potabahinquin hahcajaquin noque rahhuehihtaibo hohchabo potabahinahue. Jato potabahini coshin bi res canon bonahue, noquen Hihbaan noque hinanah bahin canoxon yobacahinnahue.

Noquen Hihbo Jesus qui noquen shinan camahahnan coshin caquin hahcajaquin tenenahue. Teneti shinan hihbo hihxon ta jaan noque hinanxon non hihti shinanyahpa hihnon caman noque hinanbonahiqui. Jaan noque hahxonni shinannahue: jihuin hueonxon rehtehah bi ta noquehon jenímaxon jaan tenenishqui. Tiromajaquin rabinmahahbaan bi ta noquehon jenimaxon jaa rabinmahi hen jahuama quescaxon jaan tenenishqui. Rahma ta Papa Dios patax hihbohi tsahoscaiqui, Quiquin Hihbo sca.
Jaan jascapa tiromabo teneni shinannahue. Teneyosmayamanahue Man yobacahinyamamis.
Hohchapan mato bihti tenequin bi tah man maton jimi potanoxon caman teneyamaparihi.
Mato jahuen baquebo jan yohicoinai huisha tah man shinanbehnohi. Jaa huishani joi ta nea qui:

content.text: Miin Hihbaan mia pontehah nincayosmayamahue, baquen. Jaan mia casticana bi yosmayamahue.
Hahan queenxon copi ta miin Hihbaan jahuen baquebo pontehihqui. Nincayamahiton ta jahuen baquebo jatihibi jaan rishquihiqui

content: hihqui jan huishani joi.
Jaan mato haxemanon tenenahue. Jahuen baquebo copi ta Papan mato pontehiqui, mato hanijaquin. ¿Jatihibi baquebo jaton papabaan hanijaquin ponteyamahihquin?
Caibo pontexon bi mato jaan ponteyama hah tah man jahuen baquema qui. Jahuenahma sca.
Noquen papabaan noque hanijaquin pontehah tah non jato nincanihqui. ¿Hashoan sca non noquen naihoh queha Papa non nincatimahin jihuenoxon?

Jaabaan bi shinanai quescajaquin res ta noquen papabaan noque pontenishqui. Noquen naihoh queha Papan ta non hashoan siri hihnon noque pontehiqui, jaa naihoh hihqui quescari non noque rihbi jihuenon, ponte.
Noque pontehah tah non bitsayamahi. Pontehah tenequin. Tenehax haxescaax, ponteboscai, jenimascai.
Noquen Hihbo man nincayamamis hihqui
Jaa copi coshinahue. Meyosmahax bi mecoshinahue. Maton raboxobo yosmascai bi tacoshcahinnahue.
Nihnoxon bahi pontebo hahnahue cojocanahibo cahax xao rechibo tsequecahinyamanon. Tarabehquetaxma man rohacananon.
Jatihibi jonibo sirijaquin yohuanquihnahue. Hohchaya jatima queenyoranahue. Hohchatima queenyamahibaan ta noquen Hihbo jisyamayaxihquiqui.
Noquen Papan matohon shinanxon mato jihuemahi bi caibo nincayamahax camis hihxon joni huetsa coirannahue. Mato tocan tiroma shinanyahpa jonin mato jahuen shinan hinanah man jaa chibanmis.
Tsiniyamabiresnahue. Esaunen hahni quesca man jamis. Jaan ta huesti coti pinoxon Papan hinantijani jenenishqui, beboquiha baque hihxon jaan bihtihi bi.
Jaa pecaho jan jeneni bihribicatsihquin cahen huaohihxon yocaxon bi bihyamascanish. Huetsa hihbomascaxon hahquirihbi bichinti hahtipahyamascaquin.
Mequeman meheti mahchi qui cahen noquen xenibo noconish, jano chihi perehihqui, cohiman mahpohah yamecahini, hihti bahquishihpi, raqueticahini. Jascapah qui tah man nocoyamahi.
Jaabaan ta corneta rehue corotai nincaxon, Papa yohuanai nincaxon, nincati teneyamascaxon Noque yohipahiyamahue hahcannishqui.
Huesti yohina bocabi joxon nea manan mehehiton tah man macaman jaa rehtetihi Papan jato jaah cahen raque teneti hahtipahyamacannish.
Hahqui raqueti jisish ta Hea tah hen hihti raquetai, raquepahhuani tah hen jai hih Moises janishqui.

Jascapa mahchi qui tah man nocoyamahi. Man hahqui nocotai ta Papan manan qui, jahuen jati, jano jaan jihuemahi jahuen naihoh queha Jerusalen, jano jahuen yonotibo tsama jai, topontimahi jano jenimahi tsinquijaquetaibo hichahi.

Naiho jaton janebo huishapaquenixon jaan tsinquihah, jano Papan beboquiha baquebo tsinquitai, janoxon jatihibi jisxon Papan caibo hahxonxon caibo casticanai, jano yamanicabo siribo jai, hahqui tah man nocotai.

Noque hahxontijanixon jayaxon Papan noque hahxonscai joni jano jai, Jesus; hahan sirijati jimi jano jai, Abelnin potani jimi quescayamahi jaa jimi copi Papan noque sirijaquin hahxonai. Jascapah qui tah man nocotai.

Jaan mato yohihah, nincayamayamanahue: man nincayosmamis. Jaan jato hihti yohihah bi nincacatsihyamahibo copi ta cahnexonma Papan noquen xenibo mahuamanishqui. Jaton casticanti jaabaan xahbanjamati hahtipahyamahiya tah non jan naihohxon noque hihti yohihi hashoan sca noquen casticanti non xahbanjamati hahtipahyamahi.
Jan jato yohihah ta mai mihuannishqui, xayati. Rahma ta jan yohini quesca sca jatihiqui: Huestijaquin sca tah hen mai res ma bi nai rihbi xayanyaxihqui, hihqui jan yohini joi.
Huestijaquin jan hihqui bi ta non rahma jisibo naiyahpa mai queyobahinti yohihiqui, xayayosmabo sca janon.
Xayayosma jihuemati ta noque hinantijanishqui. Jaa copi Hahxon tah min noque jai Papan hahxon, jaan siri jisi quescajaxon, raquetax bi jahan queenxon, jaa yocanahue.
Noquen Papa Dios ta queyomanica chihiyahpa qui.
